The Lockheed Martin Corp., Rotary and Mission Systems, Mitchel Field, New York, is awarded a $122,449,494 cost-plus-incentive-fee and cost-plus-fixed-fee contract (N0003027C3015) to provide Strategic Weapon System Trident Fleet Support, Trident II SSP Shipboard Integration Increment 8, Navigation Subsystem development efforts. This contract award also benefits a foreign military sale to the United Kingdom. This value includes optional line items, if exercised. Work will be performed in Mitchel Field, New York (77%); Huntington Beach, California (20%); Manassas, Virginia (2%); and various other locations (less than 1% each, 1% total). Work is expected to be completed by Oct. 31, 2030. This action is awarded subject to the availability of funds in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul 52.232-18. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance, Navy funds in the amount of $3,967,324; fiscal 2027 other procurement, Navy funds in the amount of $12,257,072; and fiscal 2027 shipbuilding and conversion, Navy funds in the amount of $12,966,189, will be obligated on this award. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance, Navy funds will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract is being awarded as a sole-source pursuant to 10 U.S. Code 3204(a)(1) and (4). Portfolio Acquisition Executive Strategic Systems Programs, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.
